title: Export all your data
description: Download a complete copy of your account in open formats: a tar archive of NDJSON files plus a manifest that proves every record is included. Available to account owners and admins.

status.paused: Paused at {{rows}} of {{total}} records. Resume to continue where you left off.

errors.auth: Your session expired. Sign in again, then resume the export.
errors.generic: The export was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only account owners and admins can export account data.
errors.incomplete: The server couldn’t confirm that every record was included, so no file was kept. Please try again.
errors.integrity: A data check failed, so the export was discarded. Please try again.
errors.sink: The file couldn’t be written to your device. Free up some space and try again.
